description: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a dynamic environment.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a positive, resident-centered culture. This role demands a visionary leader committed to delivering exceptional healthcare services and achieving outstanding outcomes. We offer a competitive salary and the chance to join a dedicated team focused on rehabilitation and long-term care.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated success in financial management, regulatory compliance, and staff development.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:

Previous experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility

Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives, helping them regain mobility and improve their quality of life in a supportive and dynamic environment. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about delivering high-quality, patient-centered care.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and implementing individualized physical therapy programs. You will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to ensure comprehensive care and optimal patient outcomes. This urgent opening offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to contribute immediately to a facility committed to excellence in patient rehabilitation.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida.
Master's or Doctorate degree in Physical Therapy from an accredited program.
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred.
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills.
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate ranges from $38.00 to $48.00, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
